description: What it does GetVisus is an AI visibility platform for small businesses. It checks whether ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini recommend your business or your competitors, explains why, and gives you copy-paste fixes to get recommended. Run a free 60-second audit for a 0–100 AI visibility score. Key benefits - See whether AI tools recommend you or your competitors, and why - Get a prioritised, copy-paste Fix Pack: schema, FAQ, Google Business Profile, reviews - Step-by-step "where to paste it" guidan
